title: Signal outlines limits on AI agents capturing mobile data
summary: Signal published a blog post outlining restrictions on AI agents and mobile operating-system platforms capturing user data. The post focuses on app-level access and device privacy, but the supplied material does not identify a specific technical mechanism, version, or ship date. It is therefore a stated privacy position rather than independently verified protection.
